title.rendered: Be Clean, Be Opened | Teach Me How to Pray, Day 9

excerpt.rendered: “I am willing. Be cleansed.” Four words to a leper. “Ephphatha.” One word to a deaf man’s ears. Jesus often healed with the shortest sentences in the New Testament.

title.rendered: Peace, Be Still | Teach Me How to Pray, Day 8

excerpt.rendered: The Sea of Galilee at night. A violent storm. Jesus asleep in the stern. He did not pray to the Father about the storm. He spoke directly to it. Three words. The sea obeyed.

title.rendered: The Cursed Fig Tree | Teach Me How to Pray, Day 7

excerpt.rendered: By the next morning the fig tree Jesus had spoken to was dead from the roots up. Peter noticed. Jesus used the moment to teach the disciples something about the authority their own words would carry.

title.rendered: Speak to the Mountain | Teach Me How to Pray, Day 6

excerpt.rendered: On the road from Bethany to Jerusalem, Jesus gave His disciples the clearest teaching on declarative prayer in the New Testament. He did not tell them to beg. He told them to speak to the mountain.

title.rendered: Forgive Us As We Forgive, Deliver Us From Evil | Teach Me How to Pray, Day 5

excerpt.rendered: A servant forgiven ten thousand talents walked out and seized a fellow servant by the throat over a hundred denarii. That parable is Jesus’ commentary on the next two petitions of the prayer.

title.rendered: Give Us This Day Our Daily Bread | Teach Me How to Pray, Day 4

excerpt.rendered: In first-century Judea, day labourers lived on one-day margins. The food on today’s table came from today’s work. That is the economic reality behind the fourth petition of the Lord’s Prayer.

title.rendered: Your Kingdom Come | Teach Me How to Pray, Day 3

excerpt.rendered: Most prayer begins with the believer’s agenda. Jesus taught His disciples to begin with the Father’s Kingdom and will. That reorientation changes the authority of every prayer.

title.rendered: Our Father in Heaven | Teach Me How to Pray, Day 2

excerpt.rendered: In Aramaic, Abba was the word a Jewish toddler used for a father. Jesus authorised His disciples to use that word when addressing the Creator of the universe.

title.rendered: Rising Before Daylight | Teach Me How to Pray, Day 1

excerpt.rendered: Capernaum had been the busiest day of Jesus’ public ministry. Before daylight, He was gone to a solitary place to pray. His public authority flowed from private communion.

title.rendered: Self-Control: The Fruit of the Spirit | Day 9

excerpt.rendered: Ancient Greek athletes trained under enkrateia. Mastery within. The athlete’s discipline. Paul reached for that word to name the ninth and final fruit of the Spirit.

title.rendered: Gentleness: The Fruit of the Spirit | Day 8

excerpt.rendered: Ancient Greek horse-trainers used prautēs for a warhorse trained to answer the softest touch of the rein. All the power, fully surrendered to the rider. Gentleness is trained strength.

title.rendered: Faithfulness: The Fruit of the Spirit | Day 7

excerpt.rendered: There is a kind of marriage no film ever documents. Two people who kept showing up for fifty years. Nobody films it. God calls it faithful. Faithfulness is the fruit the Spirit produces.

title.rendered: Goodness: The Fruit of the Spirit | Day 6

excerpt.rendered: Luke pauses in Acts to give Barnabas a description he gives no one else. A good man, full of the Holy Spirit and of faith. The three phrases go together.

title.rendered: Kindness: The Fruit of the Spirit | Day 5

excerpt.rendered: They dragged her into the Temple courts. The Pharisees had caught her in adultery. Jesus knelt down and wrote in the dust. What He did that morning is what the Holy Spirit is producing in you.

title.rendered: Longsuffering: The Fruit of the Spirit | Day 4

excerpt.rendered: The Greek makrothumia is a compound word. Makros means long. Thumia means temper. Long-tempered. The Holy Spirit takes the natural tendency to explode and replaces it with something rare.

title.rendered: Peace: The Fruit of the Spirit | Day 3

excerpt.rendered: The Hebrew shalom and the Greek eirēnē do not mean the absence of trouble. They mean the presence of wholeness. A deep structural rightness in the soul the storms cannot touch.

title.rendered: Joy: The Fruit of the Spirit | Day 2

excerpt.rendered: A Roman jail cell in Philippi, past midnight. Two missionaries with their backs bleeding, their feet locked in stocks. What the other prisoners heard was singing. The kind of joy the Holy Spirit produces does not depend on circumstances.

title.rendered: Love: The Fruit of the Spirit | Day 1

excerpt.rendered: Classical Greek had multiple words for love. When the New Testament wanted to describe the love that flows into a believer’s life by the Holy Spirit, it reached past all of them and chose a word that was almost forgotten. Agapē.

title.rendered: Love Your Enemies: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: The traditional teaching of Jesus’ day was tidy. Love your neighbor. Hate your enemy. It felt fair. It felt achievable. Jesus tore it in half.

title.rendered: Love One Another As I Have Loved You: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: In the upper room, on the night before the cross, Jesus rose from supper, laid aside His outer garments, tied a towel around His waist, and washed the feet of the men who would abandon Him. Then He gave them the commandment that would define Christian community for two thousand years.

title.rendered: Love Your Neighbor As Yourself: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: A traveler lay half-dead in a ditch on the road from Jerusalem to Jericho. A priest passed by. A Levite passed by. Then, unexpectedly, a Samaritan stopped. That story is Jesus’ answer to the question, “Who is my neighbor?”

title.rendered: Love the Lord Your God With All: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Every Jewish home in first-century Israel recited the Shema morning and evening. When a scribe asked Jesus which of all the commandments was the greatest, Jesus reached first for the words every listener had been praying since they could speak.

title.rendered: Lo, I Am With You Always: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: “And behold, I am with you always, to the end of the age.” A morning devotional on the promise that carries you into every tomorrow.

title.rendered: You Are My Friends: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: “No longer do I call you servants… I have called you friends.” A morning devotional on the astonishing name Jesus gives to those who follow Him.

title.rendered: Ask in My Name and You Will Receive: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: “Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be full.” A morning devotional on the open invoice Jesus has signed for those who pray in His Name.

title.rendered: Peace I Leave With You: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: “Peace I leave with you; my peace I give to you.” A morning devotional on the peace that is not from the world and cannot be taken by the world.

title.rendered: Let Not Your Hearts Be Troubled: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: “Let not your hearts be troubled. Believe in God; believe also in me.” A morning devotional on the command that is also a comfort.

title.rendered: Come to Me, All Who Are Weary: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: “Come to me, all who labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.” A morning devotional for anyone tired down to the soul.

title.rendered: One Thing You Lack: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: “Jesus, looking at him, loved him, and said, ‘You lack one thing.'” A morning devotional on the one thing that stands between us and following Jesus fully.

title.rendered: Her Sins, Which Are Many, Are Forgiven: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: “Her sins, which are many, are forgiven — for she loved much.” A morning devotional on the woman with the alabaster jar.

title.rendered: Zacchaeus: Salvation Has Come to This House: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: “Today salvation has come to this house.” A morning devotional on the tax collector Jesus went home with.

title.rendered: Once I Was Blind, Now I See: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: “One thing I do know, that though I was blind, now I see.” A morning devotional on the simplest and most powerful testimony in the Bible.

title.rendered: Do You Want to Get Well?: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: “Do you want to be healed?” A morning devotional on Jesus’ searching question to a man who had been sick for 38 years.

title.rendered: The Samaritan Woman: Living Water: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: “Whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never be thirsty again.” A morning devotional on the woman at the well and the Water your soul is looking for.

title.rendered: Nicodemus by Night: You Must Be Born Again: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: “Unless one is born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.” A morning devotional on the new birth every religious heart still needs.

title.rendered: You Are the Light of the World: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: “Let your light shine before others, so that they may see your good works and give glory to your Father.” A morning devotional on the borrowed brightness of a follower of Christ.

title.rendered: You Are the Salt of the Earth: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: “You are the salt of the earth.” A morning devotional on the quiet, preserving presence of a Christian in the world.

title.rendered: Blessed Are the Persecuted: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: “Blessed are those who are persecuted for righteousness’ sake.” A morning devotional for anyone who has paid a cost for following Christ.

title.rendered: Blessed Are the Peacemakers: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: “Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called sons of God.” A morning devotional on the family resemblance of a Christian.

title.rendered: Blessed Are the Pure in Heart: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: “Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.” A morning devotional on the undivided heart that beholds the face of God.

title.rendered: Blessed Are the Merciful: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: “Blessed are the merciful, for they shall receive mercy.” A morning devotional on the mercy that flows back to those who give it away.

title.rendered: Blessed Are Those Who Hunger for Righteousness: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: “Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be satisfied.” A morning devotional on the holy appetite God delights to fill.

title.rendered: Blessed Are the Meek: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: “Blessed are the meek, for they shall inherit the earth.” A morning devotional on the quiet strength Jesus called blessed.

title.rendered: Blessed Are Those Who Mourn: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: “Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.” A morning devotional for anyone carrying grief today.

title.rendered: Blessed Are the Poor in Spirit: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.” A morning devotional on the strange, upside-down doorway into God’s kingdom.

title.rendered: I Am the True Vine: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: “I am the true vine… abide in me, and I in you.” A morning devotional on the quiet, fruitful life of a branch that stays connected.

title.rendered: I Am the Way, the Truth, and the Life: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: “I am the way, and the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.” A morning devotional on the only Way home to God.

title.rendered: I Am the Resurrection and the Life: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: “I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in me, though he die, yet shall he live.” A morning devotional for anyone facing death, loss, or the end of hope.

title.rendered: I Am the Good Shepherd: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.” A morning devotional on the Shepherd who knows you by name.

title.rendered: I Am the Door of the Sheep: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: “I am the door. If anyone enters by me, he will be saved.” A morning devotional on the only Door into safety, salvation and life.

title.rendered: I Am the Light of the World: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: “I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will not walk in darkness.” A morning devotional on the light Jesus brings to every dark room of the human heart.

title.rendered: I Am the Bread of Life: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Jesus said, “I am the bread of life; whoever comes to me shall not hunger.” A morning devotional on the deepest hunger of the human soul and the only Bread that satisfies.

title.rendered: Abba, Father: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Every name of God this week has described what He does. This final one describes who you are to Him: not a servant crying out to a Master, but a child crying out to Abba.

title.rendered: Jehovah Shammah, the Lord Is There: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Ezekiel’s vision of the restored city ends not with a description of its walls but with a single, final name: The Lord Is There.

title.rendered: El Shaddai, God Almighty: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Abram was ninety-nine, still childless, when God appeared with a new name and a command that only made sense if the name was true: El Shaddai.

title.rendered: Jehovah Tsidkenu, the Lord Our Righteousness: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Jeremiah prophesied to a nation with corrupt kings and false shepherds, and named the coming Branch by a single, decisive title: The Lord Our Righteousness.

title.rendered: Jehovah Raah, the Lord Is My Shepherd: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: David, who had once been the shepherd, wrote of the greater Shepherd: Jehovah Raah, the Lord who leads, feeds, and stays close in the valley.

title.rendered: Jehovah Shalom, the Lord Is Peace: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Gideon expected to die after seeing the Angel of the Lord face to face. Instead he built an altar and called it Jehovah Shalom, the Lord Is Peace.

title.rendered: Jehovah Nissi, the Lord Is My Banner: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: While Moses’ hands stayed raised, Israel prevailed over Amalek. Afterward, he built an altar and named it Jehovah Nissi, the Lord Is My Banner.

title.rendered: Jehovah Rapha, the Lord Who Heals: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: At the bitter waters of Marah, God did not just sweeten the water. He revealed a name: Jehovah Rapha, the Lord who heals.

title.rendered: Jehovah Jireh, the Lord Will Provide: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: On the mountain where Abraham’s knife was already raised, God provided. The name Jehovah Jireh was not spoken until provision was needed most.

title.rendered: Elohim, the God Who Creates: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: In the beginning, Elohim spoke and the universe answered. Every name of God we will study this week starts here, with the God who creates out of nothing.

title.rendered: Humble Yourselves Under the Mighty Hand of God: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Humble yourselves under the mighty hand of God, that He may exalt you in due time. Real authority never travels without humility. The believer who wants to walk in the fullness of the power delegated to them must also walk in the fullness of the humility the King requires.

title.rendered: Every Place Where Your Foot Treads: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Every place that the sole of your foot will tread upon I have given you, as I said to Moses. Given. Past tense. The territory is already the believer’s before the foot arrives. Walking is what takes possession.

title.rendered: Power to Get Wealth: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: You shall remember the Lord your God, for it is He who gives you power to get wealth, that He may establish His covenant. The Father delegates. He delegates authority. He delegates spiritual power. He also delegates the ability to produce.

title.rendered: Standing in the Gap: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: I sought for a man among them who would make a wall, and stand in the gap before Me on behalf of the land, that I should not destroy it; but I found no one. Intercession is authority in action.

title.rendered: Not a Spirit of Fear: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind. Fear is not from the Father. Power, love, and a sound mind are. The believer facing anything today is walking in the wrong spirit if fear is leading the conversation.

title.rendered: Authority Over Sickness in His Name: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: He gave them power over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all kinds of sickness and all kinds of disease. Given. Delegated. Handed over. The authority to heal has been placed in the hands of the sent ones by the King Himself.

title.rendered: Kings and Priests to Our God: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: To Him who loved us and washed us from our sins in His own blood, and has made us kings and priests to His God and Father. Kings. Priests. Two crowns. One believer. This is the outcome of the cross for every one of us in Christ.

title.rendered: A Chosen Generation, A Royal Priesthood: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: You are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, His own special people, that you may proclaim the praises of Him who called you out of darkness into His marvelous light. Chosen. Royal. Holy. Special. This is your standing.

title.rendered: Reigning in Life Through Christ: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Those who receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness will reign in life through the One, Jesus Christ. Reign. Not endure. Not survive. Reign. This is the New Testament’s description of ordinary Christian life.

title.rendered: The Fast That Breaks Every Yoke: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Is this not the fast that I have chosen: to loose the bonds of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, to let the oppressed go free, and that you break every yoke? God’s chosen fast is not empty religion. It is authority in action.

title.rendered: The Prayer of Agreement: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: If two of you agree on earth concerning anything that they ask, it will be done for them by My Father in heaven. For where two or three are gathered together in My name, I am there in the midst of them.

title.rendered: Say to This Mountain: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Whoever says to this mountain, Be removed and be cast into the sea, and does not doubt in his heart, but believes that those things he says will be done, he will have whatever he says. Jesus put the authority in the mouth of the believer.

title.rendered: Death and Life in the Power of the Tongue: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and those who love it will eat its fruit. The words you speak today are seeds. Whatever grows from them is the harvest you will eat tomorrow.

title.rendered: If You Abide in Me: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: If you abide in Me, and My words abide in you, you will ask what you desire, and it shall be done for you. Two conditions. One extraordinary promise. Abiding is the door through which everything else in prayer walks.

title.rendered: Ask, Seek, Knock: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Ask, and it will be given to you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened to you. Three verbs. Three promises. One Father who delights to answer the child who dares to come.

title.rendered: The God of Peace Will Crush Satan Under Your Feet: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. Your feet. Not just the feet of the apostles. Not just the feet of angels. Your feet. Every believer in Christ shares in the victory the King is bringing to complete conclusion.

title.rendered: Overcome by the Blood of the Lamb: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: They triumphed over him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony; they did not love their lives so much as to shrink from death. Three ingredients of the believer’s ultimate victory. Blood. Testimony. Surrender.

title.rendered: Signs Will Accompany Those Who Believe: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: These signs will accompany those who believe: they will drive out demons, speak in new tongues, place their hands on sick people, and they will get well. Signs accompany the believer, not just the specialist.

title.rendered: Disarmed and Publicly Defeated: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Having disarmed the powers and authorities, He made a public spectacle of them, triumphing over them by the cross. Disarmed. Past tense. The believer today is not fighting an enemy at full strength.

title.rendered: The Full Armor of God: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Put on the full armor of God, so that you can take your stand against the devil’s schemes. The believer is not asked to build the armor. The armor has been forged in heaven. The instruction is simply to put it on and stand.

title.rendered: Resist the Devil and He Will Flee: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you. Two verbs. Both active. Both present tense. Both belonging to the believer. Both anchored in the finished work of Christ.

title.rendered: Greater Is He Who Is in You: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: The One who is in you is greater than the one who is in the world. Greater. Not equal to. Not a fair match. Greater. When the enemy tests the boundary of your life, he is meeting the resident Spirit of God, and he is outmatched.

title.rendered: The Weapons of Our Warfare: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: The weapons we fight with are not the weapons of the world. They have divine power to demolish strongholds. Demolish. Not shake. Not weaken. Demolish. This is what happens when the believer engages spiritual conflict in the authority of Christ.

title.rendered: The Same Power That Raised Christ: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: His incomparably great power for us who believe is that same power He exerted when He raised Christ from the dead. That same power. In you. Right now. This is the engine of every authority the believer walks in.

title.rendered: Greater Works Than These: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Whoever believes in Me will do the works I have been doing, and they will do even greater things than these. Greater. Not smaller. Not the same. Greater. This is what Jesus said about the believer’s ministry after His ascension.

title.rendered: The Name That Is Above Every Name: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: God gave Jesus the name that is above every name, that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow. Every knee. Every name. When the believer speaks in that name, every other name has to answer.

title.rendered: The Keys of the Kingdom of Heaven: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven. Whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven. The keys have been handed to the believer.

title.rendered: All Authority in Heaven and on Earth: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to Me. Then Jesus turns and sends His followers into the world. The commission is not from a delegated ruler. It is from the highest throne in the universe.

title.rendered: The Authority Given to Us: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: I have given you authority to trample on snakes and scorpions and to overcome all the power of the enemy. Given. Past tense. Already done. The believer is not searching for authority. The authority has already been placed in their hands.

title.rendered: I Am Loved With an Everlasting Love: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: The Lord said: I have loved you with an everlasting love; I have drawn you with unfailing kindness. Of all the truths about who you are in Christ, this is the deepest. Every other identity rests on this one.

title.rendered: I Am the Temple of the Holy Spirit: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Do you not know that your bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit, who is in you, whom you have received from God? The God of all creation has chosen your body as His dwelling place.

title.rendered: I Am God’s Workmanship: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: For we are God’s handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance for us to do. You are not an accident. You are the deliberate craftsmanship of the Master Artist.

title.rendered: I Am Complete in Christ: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: In Christ all the fullness of the Deity lives in bodily form, and in Christ you have been brought to fullness. Not are working toward fullness. Have been brought. The completeness is already yours.

title.rendered: I Am Hidden With Christ in God: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: For you died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God. Hidden. Not exposed. Not at risk. Your real life is tucked away inside the very life of Christ in God. Nothing can reach you there.

title.rendered: I Am Free in Christ: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: It is for freedom that Christ has set us free. Stand firm, then, and do not let yourselves be burdened again by a yoke of slavery. The believer is not trying to become free. The believer has been set free.

title.rendered: I Am Sealed With the Promised Holy Spirit: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: When you believed, you were marked in Him with a seal, the promised Holy Spirit, who is a deposit guaranteeing our inheritance. You are sealed. The deal is signed in heaven.

title.rendered: I Am Redeemed Through His Blood: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of sins, in accordance with the riches of God’s grace lavished on us. Not partial redemption. Not provisional forgiveness. Bought, washed, and brought home.

title.rendered: I Am Chosen Before the Foundation of the World: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: He chose us in Him before the creation of the world to be holy and blameless in His sight. Before the stars. Before the earth. Before time itself. The Father chose you in Christ.

title.rendered: I Am Blessed With Every Spiritual Blessing: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: God has blessed us in the heavenly realms with every spiritual blessing in Christ. Every. Not some. Not most. The believer is not waiting on the blessing. The blessing has already been given.

title.rendered: I Am More Than a Conqueror Through Christ: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: In all these things we are more than conquerors through Him who loved us. Not aspiring to conquer. Not training to conquer. More than conquerors. Past, present and future. This is who you are.

title.rendered: I Am Seated With Christ in Heavenly Places: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: God raised us up with Christ and seated us with Him in the heavenly realms in Christ Jesus. Past tense. Already done. The believer is not waiting to be seated. The believer is already there.

title.rendered: I Am the Righteousness of God in Christ: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: God made Him who had no sin to be sin for us, so that in Him we might become the righteousness of God. Not might earn. Not might work toward. Might become. This is who you are in Christ.

title.rendered: I Am a New Creation: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: If anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come. The old has gone. The new is here. Not a refurbished version of the old self. A new creation entirely. This is who you are.

title.rendered: Christ in You, the Hope of Glory: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Christ in you, the hope of glory. The mystery hidden for ages, now disclosed. Christ Himself, by His Spirit, inside the believer. This is the deepest truth about the mind of Christ.

title.rendered: The Wisdom of the Cross: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: The message of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God. The wisdom of the world cannot understand. The mind of Christ can.

title.rendered: Be Alert and of Sober Mind: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Be alert and of sober mind. Your enemy the devil prowls around like a roaring lion. Resist him. Stand firm. You are not alone. The whole family of God is going through the same.

title.rendered: Best Daily Devotionals Around the World to Read in 2026: Our Top Recommendations

excerpt.rendered: Our editor-picked list of the best daily devotionals around the world to read in 2026, including Gospelbuzz’s own The Gospel For Today, Our Daily Bread, Open Heavens, Rhapsody of Realities and more.

title.rendered: Single-Minded: Ask in Faith Without Doubting: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Ask in faith, without doubting. The double-minded person is unstable in all they do. The Christian life is not won by hedging. It is won by leaning the whole weight of the heart in one direction.

title.rendered: A Spirit of Power, Love, and a Sound Mind: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: God did not give you a spirit of fear. He gave you a spirit of power, of love and of a sound mind. Fear is not your birthright. Soundness is.

title.rendered: The Peace of God Will Guard Your Hearts and Minds: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Do not be anxious about anything. Pray about everything. And the peace of God, which transcends all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus. The mind has a watchman.

title.rendered: The Wisdom That Comes From Above: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: The wisdom that comes from above is first pure, then peace-loving, considerate, submissive, full of mercy and good fruit, impartial and sincere. Two wisdoms compete for your decisions.

title.rendered: Blessed Is the One: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Blessed is the one whose delight is in the law of the Lord, who meditates on it day and night. They are like a tree planted by streams of water. Their leaves do not wither.

title.rendered: Guard Your Heart, For Everything You Do Flows From It: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it. Not most things. Everything. The heart is the wellspring. What is in it eventually shows up everywhere.

title.rendered: Take Every Thought Captive to Obey Christ: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Take every thought captive to obey Christ. Not most thoughts. Every thought. The believer is not the helpless audience of their own mind. The believer is the appointed authority over their own mind.

title.rendered: Whatever Is True, Think on These Things: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Whatever is true, noble, right, pure, lovely, admirable, excellent or praiseworthy. Think about such things. The mind is a garden. Pay attention to what you are planting.

title.rendered: Set Your Mind on Things Above: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Set your mind on things above, where Christ is. Not on earthly things. The view from above is real. The view from below is partial. The believer is invited to live by the upper view.

title.rendered: Be Transformed by the Renewing of Your Mind: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Do not be conformed to this world. Be transformed by the renewing of your mind. The world has a shape it wants you to fit. God has a renewal He wants to work. The mind is the battleground.

title.rendered: We Have the Mind of Christ: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: We have the mind of Christ. Not we are working toward it. Have. By the indwelling Spirit, the mind of the One who upholds the universe is now in residence in you.

title.rendered: One Body, One Spirit, One Lord: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: One body. One Spirit. One hope. One Lord. One faith. One baptism. One God and Father of all. The church is not many things. It is one. And you belong.

title.rendered: Cast All Your Anxiety on Him: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Cast all your anxiety on Him because He cares for you. All of it. Not the parts you can find the words for. All of it. Onto Him. Because He is the One who actually cares.

title.rendered: The Lord Is My Strength and My Shield: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: The Lord is your strength and your shield. Your heart trusts in Him. You are helped. And from the place of help, your heart leaps for joy and your song bursts forth in thanks.

title.rendered: Run With Endurance the Race Marked Out for You: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Throw off the weight. Strip the entanglement. Run the race marked out for you. And keep your eyes on Jesus, the pioneer and perfecter of your faith.

title.rendered: Do Not Quench the Spirit: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Do not quench the Spirit. Three short words with weight. The Spirit is a fire inside you. The question is whether your daily choices fan the flame or put it out.

title.rendered: Strengthened With Power Through His Spirit in Your Inner Being: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: God’s prayer for you is that, out of His glorious riches, you may be strengthened with power through His Spirit in your inner being. The strength you need is on the inside, where He lives.

title.rendered: The Same Power That Raised Christ Lives in You: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: The Spirit who raised Jesus from the dead lives in you. The power that rolled the stone away is the same power that will see you through this day. Same Spirit. Same power. Same God.

title.rendered: Abide in the Vine: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Abide in Me, and I in you. The fruit does not come from the branch trying harder. It comes from the branch staying connected. Stay where you are loved.

title.rendered: Renewed Day by Day: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Though outwardly we are wasting away, inwardly we are being renewed day by day. The outer is fading. The inner is being made new. The Spirit is doing both simultaneously.

title.rendered: Be Filled With the Spirit: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Be filled with the Spirit. Not once. Continually. The Spirit who came at conversion is the same Spirit who fills you fresh each morning, if you will let Him.

title.rendered: More Than Conquerors Through Him Who Loved Us: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: In all these things you are more than a conqueror through Him who loved you. Not in spite of them. In them. Through Him. Today.

title.rendered: The Spirit Helps Us in Our Weakness: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: You do not have to know how to pray. You only have to come. The Spirit Himself helps you in your weakness and intercedes through you with sighs too deep for words.

title.rendered: Set Your Mind on the Things of the Spirit: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: The mind set on the flesh is death. The mind set on the Spirit is life and peace. What you set your mind on is not a small thing. It is everything.

title.rendered: Walk by the Spirit: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh. The Christian life is a walk, not a sprint, not a clenched-teeth battle. The Spirit is the One you walk with.

title.rendered: The Church the Spirit Birthed: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: The Spirit who was promised has been given. The Spirit who was given has been at work. And the Spirit who has been at work still gathers a people—the church.

title.rendered: Where the Spirit Is, There Is Freedom: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom. Not coming. Not possible. Freedom is. If the Spirit lives in you, freedom is your present-tense reality.

title.rendered: Your Body Is the Temple of the Holy Spirit: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Your body is the temple of the Holy Spirit. The dwelling of God is no longer a building. It is a person. If you belong to Christ, that person is you.

title.rendered: He Intercedes for You in Your Weakness: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: The Spirit Himself intercedes on your behalf with sighs and groanings too deep for words. When you do not know what to pray, the Spirit knows. You are not alone.

title.rendered: Sealed by the Spirit He Promised: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: God identified you as His own by giving you the Holy Spirit. The Spirit is the guarantee. Your inheritance is sealed by the very presence of God inside you.

title.rendered: The Fruit of the Spirit: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: The fruit of the Spirit. Singular. One fruit, nine flavors. We are not manufactured into godliness. We are grown into it by the One who lives in us.

title.rendered: Moved by the Impulses of the Spirit: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: The mature children of God are moved by the impulses of the Holy Spirit. Being led by the Spirit is the everyday inheritance of every son and daughter in Christ.

title.rendered: Pentecost Sunday: The Fire Has Fallen — The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Today is Pentecost Sunday. The fire that fell on the upper room is the fire that still burns in every believer. The wind that filled the house is your breath.

title.rendered: When the Day Had Fully Come: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: When the Day of Pentecost had fully come. Not partly. Not almost. Fully. God did not pick a random Tuesday. He picked the day already loaded with meaning.

title.rendered: You Will Receive Power and Ability: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: You will receive power and ability. Jesus did not promise only access. He promised the equipping that comes with it. The same Spirit moves through your day.

title.rendered: Endued With Power From on High: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Endued with power from on high. Jesus said it. The Spirit fulfilled it. You have been clothed with a power that did not begin in you. Walk in it today.

title.rendered: Wait for What the Father Promised: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Wait for what the Father promised. The instruction was for ten days in an upper room. The promise has long since come. You are walking in what they received.

title.rendered: It Is for Your Good That I Go: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Jesus said it was for our good that He was going. The departure was not the loss of His presence. It was the multiplication of it across every believer.

title.rendered: Another Advocate, With You Forever: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Another Advocate. That is what Jesus promised the Father would give. Not a substitute. Another of the same kind, with you forever. The promise still stands.

title.rendered: I Will Pour Out My Spirit: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: I will pour out my Spirit on all people. The prophecy is older than the church. Joel saw it eight hundred years before Pentecost. The promise stood.

title.rendered: His Love Never Fails: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Love never fails. Three words. Everything in 1 Corinthians 13 turns on this hinge. Prophecies cease. Knowledge passes away. But love is not a partial expression of something greater. Love is the thing itself. And it never fails.

title.rendered: Cast All Your Anxiety on Him: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you. Not manage it. Not reduce it. Cast all of it, in one decisive act of trust. Because He cares. Not as an obligation but as genuine, active, personal concern for you specifically.

title.rendered: He Who Calls You Is Faithful: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: He will do it. Paul closes his instructions not with more commands but with a promise. The One who called you is faithful. Your transformation is not a project you manage. It is a work He performs. Rest in His faithfulness, not your consistency.

title.rendered: You Are Hidden with Christ in God: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Your life is hidden with Christ in God. Not exposed, not vulnerable, not at the mercy of circumstances. To reach you, anything that wants to harm you would have to go through God first, then through Christ. That is the security you live in.

title.rendered: His Mercy Is New Every Morning: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Jeremiah wrote these words from the ruins of a destroyed Jerusalem. His compassions never fail. They are new every morning. That is faith spoken not from comfort but from the ash heap. And it is true in both places.

title.rendered: He Chose You Before the Foundation of the World: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Before the world existed, before time began, God chose you. Not in response to something you would do. He chose you in love, for adoption as His child, because that is what gave Him pleasure. The initiative has always been entirely His.

title.rendered: Nothing Can Separate You from His Love: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Nothing can separate you from the love of God in Christ Jesus. Not death, not life, not angels, not demons, not the present, not the future. Paul has looked at every threatening reality and dismissed every one. His love holds.

excerpt.rendered: Not I lack less. Not I have enough to get by. I lack nothing. The Lord is my shepherd, personal, attentive, present, and in His care, the cup doesn’t just fill. It overflows.

title.rendered: I Am the Vine, You Are the Branches: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Jesus does not say try harder to produce fruit. He says remain. The branch does not strain, it stays connected. Fruit is not your achievement. It is the overflow of abiding in the vine.

title.rendered: Greater Is He That Is in You: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: You have overcome, past tense, settled, done. Not because of your strength but because of the One in you. Greater is He that is in you than he that is in the world. Act accordingly.

title.rendered: You Have the Mind of Christ: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Four words that change everything: we have the mind of Christ. Not a goal to reach, a reality already true about every believer. You are not limited to your own understanding today.

title.rendered: There Is Now No Condemnation: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: The verdict has already been given, not guilty. Romans 8:1 is not a goal to reach. It is the truth about you right now, in Christ Jesus. No condemnation. Not after you improve. Now.

title.rendered: Rooted and Built Up in Him: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: You received Christ by grace through faith, and the same way you received Him is the same way you live in Him. Rooted and built up. Not striving and performing. The life of grace is a life of drawing, not straining.

title.rendered: You Are the Righteousness of God: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: You did not earn it and you cannot lose it, you are the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus. Not after you improve. Right now, by faith, through the finished work of the cross.
